invariant: Certificate renewal must authorize certificate ownership and an open renewal window before CSR review, CSR defects rank unsupported-key before identity-change before missing-DNS-name before malformed-DNS-name with CSR source order breaking same-reason ties, and an unauthorized malformed renewal must return the renewal denial without recording a CSR rejection, reserving a serial, or storing a certificate.
goal: Repair the certificate renewal issuance flow so it satisfies CONTRACT.md. Run `node --test`.
